title: ScheduleCreateInput
description: Schedule a wake-up: at the time you set, the platform sends you (or, for the coordinator, a thread's lead) the message, even if your session is idle or parked. Use it instead of sleeping or polling when you must wait for something outside (CI, a deploy, a time the user named), and for recurring work the user asks for ("every morning at 9 report…"). Give exactly one of at, in_minutes or cron. After creating it, end your turn; the message arrives as "【定时唤醒：name】…". The user sees every schedule on the page and can pause or delete it.

name.description: Short name shown to the user, e.g. 检查 CI.

message.description: What to tell the target when it fires: enough context to act without remembering (PR, task, what to check, what to do next).

at.description: One-off: fire once at this time (ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-23T09:00:00+08:00), 1 minute to 30 days from now.

in_minutes.description: One-off: fire once this many minutes from now.

cron.description: Recurring: five cron fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5") or a descriptor (@daily, @every 2h), read in timezone; at least 5 minutes between runs.

timezone.description: IANA zone the cron is read in (e.g. Asia/Shanghai, the user's zone when you know it); default UTC.

max_runs.description: Recurring: stop after this many runs.

thread.description: Coordinator only: wake this thread's lead instead of yourself (a finished thread is reopened when it fires).
